column2: It's true, ma'am!
Is it true?\n\nOh, honestly, you should've said so sooner, Banji!
I DID say so!
When he went to school, nobody was there...?
Could it be that thing...
You got some idea what's goin' on?
Actually...
My blood's pumpin'...!
Hey, Ma!
Hearing that, don't you feel the urge to fight, Banji!? I don't remember raising you to be that kind of kid!
{p}-kun! Banchiyo Suke will help you! You hear me, Banji! You too, Danshi-chan!
Huh? Me too!?
Don't worry! I'll protect Danshi!
Good to have ya, Akira! {p}!
So this is... Kaim Sirene.\n\nSo terrifying... and so beautiful...
A black fiend is on Kaim Sirene's body...!
GYAAAAH!\n\nCurse you, who dares try to take over my body!
Curse you, was it you!?
...Uhh... nnn...\n\nHuh!? Wh-what happened to me...?
You were being controlled by a black fiend.
A black fiend? What's that...?
Actually...
To think I'd be saved by a human... Sirene the bird-demon has truly fallen low...
But! This is no time for that! {p}! If your story is true, an enemy surpassing even we Demons is after the surface! I'll lend you a hand.\n\nI won't let this Earth be taken by some Demon King!
So this is... Kaim Sirene.
I've never known an enemy as strong and beautiful as her...
Get back, {p}!
Look at that!
A black fiend is on Kaim Sirene's body...!
GYAAAAH!\n\nCurse you, who dares try to take over my body!
Curse you, Devilman! You again!?
...Uhh... nnn...
Huh!? Wh-what happened to me...?
Sirene, you were being controlled by a black fiend.
A black fiend? What's that...?
Actually...
To think I'd be saved by you of all people...\n\nSirene the bird-demon has truly fallen low...
If you don't like it, I can finish you off, y'know.
Akira-kun!
This Demon King truly means to make the world his own?
That's right.
Then, {p},\n\nmuch as it galls me, I, Sirene, will lend you a hand. I won't let this Earth be taken by some Demon King!
Sirene...
But Devilman! Don't think I'm joining hands with you! After the Demon King falls...
I'll take you on as many times as you like, Sirene!
Ohohoho! Congratulations! You've been chosen as one of our store's top VIP customers!!
VIP customer!?
Oh my!? We're all out of commemorative gifts. Ohohoho, oh well. I'll just give you me as the gift!
Whaaat!!
Big sis, you're leavin'? What about the store?
Hmm, I suppose it'd be bad with nobody here... Oh, I know, little brother, you run it!
Me!?\n\nAll right! I'll mind the store while big sis is away!!
I'm glad you're coming, but are you ready to head out?
As long as I've got sticking plasters instead of clothes, I'm fine! Even on a frozen plain in a blizzard, no problem! Now, let's go! Ohohoho!

Muhuhuhu, I'm the original creator, Ken Ishikawa, you know. You found all my characters, didn't you. Shinichi and Miroku are reliable guys, you know. From here on, I'll help you out too. I'll give it my all, just like Getter, you know!
Ahahaha! I'm the original creator, gasu! Go Nagai, gasu! Thanks for playing so much, gasu! From now on, I'll be helping out too, gasu! Nice to meet ya, gasu!
We finally did it! We won! But with the Demon King gone, our pharmacy will lose customers... I wonder if the Demon King will come back to life just once more?
Please don't say such ominous things. Mamii-kun is waiting for you. You'd better head home soon.
I suppose so, ohohoho! Agreed, agreed, and perfectly pH-balanced!
Say hi to Mamii-kun for me!\n\nShe really was a funny lady.
Muhuhuhu.
Thank you very much, Ishikawa-sensei.
You did it, huh? You finally beat the Demon King.
It's all thanks to you, Ishikawa-sensei, and everyone who joined us.
Every one of those characters is a tough guy, you know. I'll keep drawing tough characters one after another, so look forward to Dynamic's manga! Well then, see you again!
Take care, sensei!!
Ahahaha.
Thank you very much, Nagai-sensei.
That was fun, gasu! Let's play together again, gasu! Well then, goodbye, gasu!!
Huh? Come to think of it, the Dimension Chain the Demon King tried to destroy is a world Nagai-sensei created... I hope the Demon King doesn't figure that out and go after sensei...
Ahahaha! It's fine, gasu! My pen is invincible, gasu!
Yeah, he really does seem fine!
In fading letters, it says "Hill of Beginnings."
Better safe than sorry! Mamii Pharmacy ahead.
Put your hands together for the Jizo statue.\n\nInjuries and illness will heal at once, and everyone will be full of energy.
It says "St. Chapel Academy."
HP and DP restored! Everyone is full of energy!

Thank you very much!
Welcome!
Thank you very much!

Welcooome!
Thank you very muuuch!
Don't forget to equip accessories on the status screen. Just carrying them does nothing.

{p} can now be swapped out too. Change party members?
Change party members?
I saw this town on the news the other day and got a shock. But... did anything newsworthy happen here?
Things have been weird lately.\n\nThe tap water stinks, and when I drink it my stomach hurts.
At this rate, I can't even go mountain climbing, my hobby...
They say there's a place called Science City. When did that get built? Was it just me who didn't know...? Hmm, maybe...?
Southeast of this town there's a place called the Reaper Police HQ. If you value your life, stay away.
At the southern tip of Kanto, there's a place called the Quake Fort. They say orphans of the Kanto Hellquake gather there to live.
I've decided to get a dog.\n\nGuess I'll start by building a doghouse.
I built a doghouse and everything, planning to get a dog... But I decided to get a cat after all!
